title: Pauli Propagation for Imaginary-Time Evolution
summary: We extend the Pauli Propagation framework to imaginary-time evolution and introduce imaginary-time Pauli Propagation (ITPP), an operator-based algorithm for approximating thermal and ground-state properties directly in the Pauli basis. We derive explicit imaginary-time propagation rules for Pauli strings and analyze the main approximation errors arising from Trotterization and Pauli-space truncation, including bounds that account for the non-unitary nature of the evolution.
